top_signals.title: Stocks and Bonds Slip as Oil Ends Run of Losses: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stock futures slipped as crude prices ended their longest losing streak this year, with traders waiting for further progress in efforts to end the US-Iran war. The dollar hit the highest level since July.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Supply Pressurei in Container Vessel Sector
top_signals.summary: "Disruptions and strong growth in head-haul trades continue to support the container shipping market in 2026, but accelerating fleet growth could weaken the supply/demand balance in 2027,” says Niels Rasmussen, Chief Shipping Analyst at BIMCO.BIMCO continues to forecast two scenarios.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
top_signals.summary: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.
